prompt: Two study partners agree to 'keep each other motivated' with encouraging messages, but neither checks whether work happened, and both drift. What would make the accountability actually work?

options.text: A specific, checkable commitment each shares proof of, such as sending a photo of completed problem sets every Friday
Harsher criticism when one of them drifts
Keeping goals private so there is no pressure

explanation: Encouragement without verification changes nothing. Accountability works when the commitment is specific and the other person can actually see whether it was kept.
